subject: The RWebSocket unexpectedly closed. Inspect your Shiny app and refresh your browser window

messages.author: e42372d1a189c734
messages.subject: The RWebSocket unexpectedly closed. Inspect your Shiny app and refresh your browser window
parts:
Hi all,

I have just set up an experimental web app on the shiny server. The page loads as expected from my local tests. However, when I try to source an input file from my local system (using the 'choose file' button), I get the following error in a web popup box:

'The RWebSocket unexpectedly closed. Inspect your Shiny app and refresh your browser window'

You can see the problem for yourself at http://glimmer.rstudio.com/kkeenan/diveRsity-online/

Does anyone know what might be the issue?

Thanks

Kevin

p.s. shiny and Rstudio are amazing

I'm also getting this reported on an app I have been successfully running (and haven't knowingly changed) prior to today:
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/psychemedia/wightsitrep

In the case of this app, I am bringing data in using download.File and tempfile() via calls in global.R:

#Loading in CSV directly from https seems to cause problems but this workaround seems okay
floader=function(fn){
  temporaryFile <- tempfile()
  download.file(fn,destfile=temporaryFile, method="curl")
  read.csv(temporaryFile)
}

#This is the data source - a scraperwiki API call
#It would make sense to abstract this further, eg allowing the creation of the URL based around a passed in a select statement
u="https://api.scraperwiki.com/api/1.0/datastore/sqlite?format=csv&name=nhs_sit_reps&query=select%20SHA%2CName%2C%20fromDateStr%2CtoDateStr%2C%20tableName%2CfacetB%2Cvalue%20from%20fulltable%20%20where%20Name%20like%20'%25WIGH%25'"

#Load the data and do a bit typecasting, just in case...
d=floader(u)
